propositions: Bridge runner core must be extracted into a runner-neutral packaged Python module exposed through rebar.bridge_run(), CLI rebar bridge run --profile, and MCP bridge_run tool
Five provider profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) must map to existing rebar commands while preserving legacy MODE environment variable compatibility
Packaged runner must enforce environment validation, 3600-second timeout, pause-marker validation, and strict ticket-store delivery with run id and bot identity
Wheel must be installable and functional from pip, Homebrew wheel-backed, and MCP Registry/uvx; provider wrappers must invoke installed rebar bridge run entrypoint without repository-local scripts
Legacy benign reconcile results (3/4/75) must remain unchanged for direct callers; provider runner must translate them to canonical 0 success
Provider wrappers (GitHub, Jenkins, GitLab) must be schema-validated and pass pinned ShellCheck linting; GitLab schema provenance must record immutable upstream revision and SHA-256
